title: Emotions and malls
content: Im pretty sure my emotions determine what I dream about and I think that’s where my mall world comes from. In real life when I am in malls I’m usually anxious - lost, tired, can’t find the store I’m looking for, exhausted, sad because the mall is dying, annoyed about spending money, probably have to pee. So when I’m most anxious it seems normal my emotional state would invent a mall to explain my anxiety. Same for airports. (My mall world is also an airport and an underground parking lot with stores in it).
